reviewType: source-based release impact assessment, not an integration result
assessmentStatus: complete within declared scope; parent consolidation and compatibility decision pending

graphVerification.coverage: All 12 Go paths metadata_match/no_recorded_issue at final coverage generation; initial graph symbol/trace/snippet exploration used05:37:20Z. Direct source reads used for material behavior. Best effort; not a completeness proof.

scope.production: DC apps.openshift.io/v1; apps/v1 Deployments/ReplicaSets; autoscaling/v2 HPA; corev1 Pods/RCs/Services/Endpoints/quotas/limits/PVC/PV/Nodes/namespace labels; network policies/PDB; authorizationv1 SSAR/LSAR; OpenShift SCC subject review/AppliedClusterResourceQuota; optional admin policy discovery; image-trigger annotation/controller behavior. Full inventory in docs/compatibility-review.md.
scope.harness: Additional core/RBAC/Lease/Route/image/build/template/ClusterVersion/TokenRequest/isolated quota and storage fixtures from the documented inventory. Harness creates resources explicitly and cannot assume old server behavior from 4.21 execution.
scope.method: Read extracted candidates for 4.19/4.20, inspect surrounding source/mandatory API removal and known-issue sections, search full immutable release notes and errata modules by inventory/behavior; correlate relevant field/default/controller/accounting/storage/security changes with code, baseline catalog and primary upstream resource-accounting helpers. 4.21 includes immutable release-note assembly and all 51 retrieved referenced sources (50 content sources plus commit response); targeted relevant entries and complete section-heading scan, rather than claiming line-by-line review of every unrelated product feature.
scope.excluded: No cluster upgrade execution, no removed/manual post-baseline feature qualification, no guarantee of runtime image pulls/CSI mounts/network connectivity/CPUManager device or NUMA fit, no blanket validation of every platform-specific operator or all CVE fixed versions. These are prerequisites/explicit manual features, not missing API translation fixes.

limits: Older server integrations are unavailable; this record contains no synthetic integration passes.
API dry run and access reviews are current evidence, not a reservation or a guarantee against later RBAC/admission/quota/policy/capacity drift.

The existing preflight report explicitly says scheduler plugins, CSI attachment limits, volume mounting and external network dependencies are not simulated; runtime startup and recovery remain independently checked.
Client-library compilation/security and final exact-artifact integration qualification are consolidated parent work.

Advisory bullets relevant to tool operations were assessed; this is not a blanket claim that every patch is vulnerability-free or that Red Hat backports correspond one-to-one with upstream patch numbers.

findings.change: Kubernetes1.32 removes flowcontrol.apiserver.k8s.io/v1beta3; OpenShift documents inadvertently reintroduced admissionregistration/v1beta1
findings.assessment: Neither production nor fixture inventory creates APF or webhook/policy configuration objects. Existing stable workload/authorization/quota/OpenShift APIs remain the actual endpoints. No automatic change to unrelated policies or cluster capabilities is needed.
findings.validationOrRequiredAction: Retain exact GVR discovery and endpoint error handling. Do not advertise generic removed-API compatibility beyond inventory.

findings.change: Node-bound/JTI/node-info tokens, legacy cleanup, external signer; 1.32 node-audience feature reverted for azureFile regression
findings.toolPaths: preflight.go:access; runtime.go kubeconfig loader; constraints.go SCC/admission; tools TokenRequest fixtures
findings.assessment: Converter treats credentials as opaque and preserves service-account/projection settings. It does not parse JWT claims or depend on automatic legacy secrets. Official1.32 patch warns not to enable ServiceAccountNodeAudienceRestriction with token-dependent in-tree/CSI migration; this is a cluster/storage prerequisite and not fixed by changing converter token shape.
findings.validationOrRequiredAction: Use valid kubeconfig/TokenRequest credentials; expiration/revocation must remain a surfaced failure with explicit recovery. Review token-dependent CSI setup, not only API availability.

findings.change: Pod-level resources and seLinuxChangePolicy added; DRA structured API changes
findings.toolPaths: baseline.go:validateBaseline; constraints.go SCC/Pod raw spec guard; scheduling.go:checkScheduling
findings.assessment: PodSpec.resources and PodSecurityContext.seLinuxChangePolicy are absent from1.27 catalog and are refused before typed decode/retirement; this includes admission-added fields. ResourceClaims/custom scheduler paths require manual review. Stable baseline hostUsers/resizePolicy fields remain preserved rather than being confused with newly added fields.
findings.validationOrRequiredAction: Existing admission/raw-field, HPA-baseline and source-retirement contract suites cover the conservative policy; final client upgrade must retain it.

findings.change: AllocatedResources status gate and in-place resize/native sidecar scheduling accounting
findings.assessment: Raw current-Pod inventory includes container/init status resources and allocatedResources maxima; restartable init sidecars/peak init/overhead are counted. Source Pods are not credited as free capacity. Pod budgets override per-resource container totals and then add overhead, matching upstream1.33/1.34 helpers. Infeasible resize retains spec max and may overestimate relative to upstream; no demonstrated undercount.
findings.validationOrRequiredAction: TestObservedAllocationsIncludeResizeAndNewPodBudgets and TestPodAccountingIncludesInitSidecarsAndOverhead; final-artifact suite remains parent responsibility.

findings.change: Legacy attach-limit scheduler plugins/node allocatable counts removed; CSI migration and runtime known issues
findings.assessment: 1.32 uses CSINode driver limits rather than legacy node attachable-volume counts. Tool reads bound claim/PV/topology and rejects removed CephFS/RBD, but does not claim complete CSI attach/driver placement simulation. Portworx CSI migration needs installed driver/security secrets.4.19 vSAN NFS note requires latest ESXi/vSAN8.0P05 or later; vSphere resize/recovery improvements are outside converter write operations.
findings.validationOrRequiredAction: Require functioning supported CSI driver/storage platform and review attachment/mountability before exclusive cutover. No new removed-volume-field rule is justified for transparently migrated supported drivers.

findings.change: OpenShift VAP enforcement fixed for BuildConfig/DeploymentConfig; SCC pinning/default fixes
findings.assessment: Source preflight dry-runs planned freeze/stop/park specs and compares admitted specs. setSourceSpec repeats exact dry run before each actual update, retaining actual endpoint errors. Actual workload SA/groups and required-SCC authorization are checked separately from caller admin Pod admission. Fixed VAP enforcement can correctly turn former acceptance into refusal; do not suppress it.

findings.change: ReplicaSet event text changes; HPAContainerMetrics stable gate removed; Ready-probe timing corrected
findings.assessment: Tool evaluates API ownership/spec/status/Ready/health instead of parsing ScalingReplicaSet event prose. HPAContainerResource v2 fields are preserved and the HPA is frozen/retargeted/restored, not recalculated by converter. Corrected readiness latency and CPUManager restart issues require appropriate runtime timeout/capacity, not fabricated Ready status.
findings.validationOrRequiredAction: Use observed Ready/HTTP and bounded waits; do not assert that a capacity snapshot models static CPUManager/NUMA runtime.

findings.change: Mirror-only ImageStream import fix; schema1 digest fix; MultiNetworkPolicy/IPsec known behavior
findings.toolPaths: converter.go image trigger annotation; cutover.go health; qualification image/build/Route fixtures
findings.assessment: The converter preserves image references/Pod annotations and emits existing image trigger API format; it does not import/mirror images or rewrite Services/CNI. Import under NeverContactSource uses supported mirror configuration; actual image pull and network/secondary-network reachability require runtime checks. Core NetworkPolicy/admin selector preservation is not a full MultiNetworkPolicy/IPsec traffic simulation.
findings.validationOrRequiredAction: Qualification imports/builds must succeed explicitly; compatible image trust/registry/CNI and external connectivity are prerequisites. No image-controller API format break found in scoped notes.

findings.change: Upstream NodeRestriction/DRA/node-log/checkpoint CVEs and platform/operator errata
findings.toolPaths: production API inventory; tools qualification inventory
findings.assessment: Named CVEs affect compromised node authorization, DRA, Windows nodes/logs/query or Kubelet checkpoint operations; converter does not call those vulnerable endpoints or configure the node authorizer. Running a suitably patched cluster remains a prerequisite; passing converter tests cannot certify cluster security.
findings.validationOrRequiredAction: Do not infer Red Hat fixed builds from upstream patch alone. Current dependency vulnerability checks are distinct from server CVE posture.

conclusion: No additional demonstrated unsafe acceptance in the conventional baseline feature path was established by this bounded source review. Existing guards preserve or refuse changed feature semantics, with named runtime/platform/storage/image/authorization prerequisites. This is input to the parent consolidated compatibility assumption; it is not a blanket per-patch support or integration pass.
